tasks.label: Verify login
tasks.command: node -e "const payload = { username: 'dicksondogbe49@gmail.com', password: 'D!I!C!K!S!O!N&' }; fetch('http://localhost:3000/api/login', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(payload) }).then(async (r) => { const text = await r.text(); console.log('STATUS=' + r.status); console.log(text); }).catch((e) => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });"

tasks.label: Verify login via PowerShell
tasks.command: $body = @{ username = 'dicksondogbe49@gmail.com'; password = 'D!I!C!K!S!O!N&' } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/login -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body

tasks.label: Restart app
tasks.command: cmd /c "taskkill /F /IM node.exe /T && cd /d "C:\Users\user\Desktop\LOGIN INFO" && npm.cmd start"

tasks.label: Verify role login
tasks.command: $body = @{ username = 'dicksondogbe49@gmail.com'; password = 'D!I!C!K!S!O!N&'; role = 'admin' } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/login -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body

tasks.label: Verify role enforcement
tasks.command: $body = @{ username = 'dicksondogbe49@gmail.com'; password = 'D!I!C!K!S!O!N&'; role = 'doctor' } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/login -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Check running Node
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'node.exe' } | Select-Object Name, ProcessId, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: Start app via PowerShell
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { Set-Location 'C:/Users/user/Desktop/LOGIN INFO'; npm.cmd start }"

tasks.label: Validate role selection
tasks.command: $valid = @{ username = 'dicksondogbe49@gmail.com'; password = 'D!I!C!K!S!O!N&'; role = 'admin' } | ConvertTo-Json; Write-Host 'VALID:'; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/login -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $valid; Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'INVALID:'; try { $invalid = @{ username = 'dicksondogbe49@gmail.com'; password = 'D!I!C!K!S!O!N&'; role = 'doctor' } | ConvertTo-Json; Invoke-RestMethod -Uri http://localhost:3000/api/login -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $invalid -ErrorAction Stop | Out-Null; Write-Host 'unexpected success' } catch { $_.Exception.Message }
